title: How many days old?
instruction: Greet the user, then ask their age. Work out roughly how many days they have been alive, then how many hours that is. input() always gives you text, so turn the age into a number with int().
hint: Ask, then work it out, then print: data has to exist before you can use it.

blocks.code: print(f"You have been alive for about {days} days.")

expectedOutput: You have been alive for about 4380 days.
